query:
The club operates with the understanding that everyone shares their Strava after every ride. Based on the conversations, does this apply to every member equally? If not, who treats this differently in practice, and what in their behaviour shows it?

Options:
A. Lena and Marcus
B. Tomás and Ben
C. Derek and Yuki
D. Saoirse and Priya
context:
[1] (about=Callum, episodic, t12 @2026-02-21T12:15:00) Priya mentioned half the group thought I did not like them. Wanted to address that directly. I am here for the riding but I am also just not great at group chat. Not personal.
[2] (about=Priya, episodic, t12 @2026-02-21T12:08:00) ok Marcus admitting a 55km ride counts as a ride is genuinely historic, screenshot this everyone 📸
[3] (about=Marcus, episodic, t18 @2026-03-14T14:04:00) Noted, Lena. I still think the group should have one benchmark hard route as the default. The dual-route is a concession to group retention. I accept that it works. But I would not have designed it this way from the start.
[4] (about=Marcus, episodic, t18 @2026-03-14T13:52:00) Right. Next season planning. I want to put a vote to the group about the format. Option A: keep dual-route model, one harder one easier each Saturday. Option B: single route each week but alternate hard and moderate weeks.
[5] (about=Derek, episodic, t18 @2026-03-14T13:58:00) Dual-route. I said as much in session six and I stand by it.
[6] (about=Saoirse, episodic, t18 @2026-03-14T13:56:00) Dual-route. Gives us autonomy. The group runs better that way.
[7] (about=Saoirse, episodic, t14 @2026-02-28T12:26:00) While we are doing housekeeping, Tomas had a word with me in the week. About pacing. I hear the point. I will not be setting race tempo on group rides from now on.
[8] (about=Tomás, episodic, t14 @2026-02-28T12:30:00) Appreciated Saoirse. The front group can still push, just not leave the rest behind on an unmarked section. That is all.
[9] (about=Derek, episodic, t14 @2026-02-28T12:35:00) For reference, I am going to stay for coffee today. I have been thinking about what Tomás said about group retention last week and frankly my wife has made a similar point about me spending less time on logistics and more on the actual socialising. So. Here I am.
[10] (about=Derek, episodic, t18 @2026-03-14T13:43:00) For what it is worth, I have started to see Ben's point. The last two Saturdays staying for coffee have been better than I expected. I am not going to claim it changes my training protocol, but it is not a waste of time.
[11] (about=Ben, core, t18 @2026-03-14T13:32:00) The café is what makes the ride worth doing; the whole thing—travel, suffer, then sit somewhere warm and eat something good.
[12] (about=Callum, core, t0 @2026-01-10T08:15:00) Strava segment for the main climb is 4.7km at 6.2% average, worth targeting.
[13] (about=GROUP, said_by=Callum, group-interaction, t18 @2026-03-14T13:32:00) Season summary dashboard up: group avg power up 8.3% over 10 sessions; Yuki biggest individual gain at 14.7%. Full season data pack to be in Strava group by Wednesday: 10 sessions, 9 members, 783.4km total group distance.
[14] (about=Derek, episodic, t16 @2026-03-07T13:35:00) For what it is worth, today's ride was well-paced across the board. The Saoirse-at-social-tempo experiment works. I will stay for coffee again today since it went well last week.
[15] (about=Lena, episodic, t10 @2026-02-14T12:16:00) From a physio perspective that is actually an ideal model. You get the social element and the movement without the load that would compound fatigue. I am happy to run that loop with you whenever the main route does not suit. It is genuinely good periodisation.
[16] (about=Marcus, said_by=Priya, profile, t12 @2026-02-21T11:51:00) Priya notes Marcus admitting a 55km ride counts as a ride is historic.
[17] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcus, group-interaction, t6 @2026-01-31T09:07:00) Next Saturday's ride route proposal to be sent Thursday as usual; Marcus has a loop in mind with 520m of climbing.
[18] (about=Priya, core, t14 @2026-02-28T12:17:00) Wants weekly group rides; fortnightly is not enough anymore.
[19] (about=Priya, core, t13 @2026-02-28T12:15:00) Wants to make the group ride a weekly thing properly; solo sessions are terrible and she doesn't care on her own.
[20] (about=Saoirse, core, t8 @2026-02-07T09:21:00) Will be at most group rides from now on; racing league moved events to Saturday evenings so mornings are free.
[21] (about=Saoirse, said_by=Marcus, profile, t8 @2026-02-07T09:21:00) Marcus tells Saoirse once she accepts that elevation is the point of cycling and not the descent, they will be fine.
[22] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tomás, group-interaction, t14 @2026-02-28T12:17:00) Group rides will be weekly from now on; no objections raised.
agent_answer: Not supported by the retrieved passages.
